chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from Muhammad ibn Isa, from one of his companions, from Ibrahim ibn Abi al-Bilad, from Ali ibn al-Mughira, from Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him), who said:
From the misery of life is the bad mount.
ai.seo_question: What is considered a source of misery in life according to Imam al-Baqir?
ai.summary: Imam Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) identifies an uncomfortable mount as a source of life's misery, reflecting the Shia emphasis on how physical ease facilitates spiritual focus and social dignity. This narration underscores the practical wisdom that material comfort is not merely a luxury but a foundational element for a balanced and less burdensome existence.
